message.content:
This editorial illustration shows a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black capital letters. Below the masthead, "50 Tahun!" is written in a stylized black script. The cover art depicts a central male figure wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and trousers. He holds a red, rope-like lasso that extends upward, looping around the letter "E" in "TEMPO." He is surrounded by numerous silhouetted figures seen from behind, rendered in dark blue and grey tones. In the lower right, another male figure in a grey shirt is depicted facing the viewer, looking toward the central man.

Large white text on the right reads: "SIASAT BARU MENAGIH DANA BLBI." Below this, smaller white text describes government actions regarding Bank Indonesia Liquidity Support. Additional text at the top reads "KISRUH VAKSIN COVID KETIGA" and "DI BALIK PENANGKAPAN BUPATI PROBOLINGGO." The bottom left corner contains the date "6-12 SEPTEMBER 2021," a price of "RP 45.000," a QR code, and a barcode. The overall color palette consists of reds, blues, greys, and white.
